scene.room: kitchen in a 1938 California bungalow, remodeled; galley / L-shaped layout with a built-in breakfast banquette nook at the far end
scene.view: wide-angle interior three-quarter view from the near corner, looking down the length of the kitchen toward a bank of windows and a banquette nook; two-point perspective

camera.angle: shot from the near-left corner looking toward the far window nook, both side walls receding

lighting.primary: bright soft natural daylight flooding from the bank of windows at the far end and the sink window, late morning, Northern California
lighting.secondary: warm under-cabinet LED strip, 2700K, and recessed ceiling downlights

layout.left_wall: sink run in the foreground-left, receding toward the nook
layout.far_end: built-in breakfast banquette nook beneath a bank of windows
layout.right_wall: range and tall-pantry run in the foreground-right, receding toward the nook

elements.name: left_sink_run
elements.type: L-shaped run of shaker-style base cabinets along the left wall with a white fireclay UNDERMOUNT sink beneath a window
elements.color: Sherwin-Williams Dried Thyme SW 6186 (muted gray-sage green) cabinets
elements.faucet: aged unlacquered brass gooseneck faucet, burnished patina
elements.hardware: aged unlacquered brass bar pulls and knobs, burnished, not shiny gold
elements.detail: quartz counter; two stacked floating white oak shelves above the counter near the window, styled with a small trailing potted plant and a few cream ceramics

elements.name: breakfast_nook
elements.type: built-in upholstered banquette bench wrapping the far corner beneath a bank of three double-hung windows
elements.furniture: natural white oak dining table with two modern light-wood chairs, cream seats
elements.detail: bright daylight through the windows, painted Alabaster window trim, soft out-of-focus garden greenery beyond

elements.name: right_range_run
elements.type: run along the right wall with a professional range under a wood-wrapped hood, flanked by tall pantry and cabinetry
elements.range: professional-style Thermador range, stainless, 6-burner, centered on the wall
elements.hood: custom natural white oak wrapped range hood with a slim stainless insert, matching the oak shelves and floor
elements.tall_cabinets: floor-to-ceiling Alabaster shaker pantry cabinets toward the nook end of this wall
elements.uppers: Alabaster shaker upper cabinets flanking the hood, small aged brass knobs
elements.secondary_appliances: stainless wall oven with a microwave above it, built into Alabaster cabinetry on the near-right
elements.lowers: Sherwin-Williams Dried Thyme SW 6186 sage green shaker base cabinets with aged brass bar pulls
elements.counter: quartz counter matching the sink run

elements.name: backsplash
elements.type: handmade Moroccan zellige tile, 4x4 inch squares, tight grid, minimal grout, on both the sink wall and the range wall
elements.color: warm white / weathered white with natural tonal variation from cream to ivory, glossy reflective glaze, slightly irregular handmade surfaces catching the light

elements.name: countertop
elements.appearance: polished off-white base with sparse, soft grey pencil-thin veining, subtle and understated, NOT bold marble veining

elements.name: upper_cabinets_color
elements.color: Sherwin-Williams Alabaster SW 7008 (warm creamy white), matching the walls exactly

elements.name: walls_and_trim
elements.type: smooth painted walls and simple 1938-appropriate trim
elements.color: Sherwin-Williams Alabaster SW 7008, eggshell walls, satin trim

elements.name: floor
elements.type: site-finished white oak plank flooring, 5 inch planks, running the length of the room
elements.finish: natural unstained, clear waterborne matte finish, no orange or amber tones, matches the floating shelves and range hood

style_references: editorial interior photography, Architectural Digest quality
negative: no farmhouse apron-front sink; the sink is undermount
no bold dramatic marble veining on the quartz
no orange, pink, or honey-toned wood; oak is natural and neutral
no clutter, no people, no text or watermarks

output.notes: hold the exact paint relationships: sage lowers must read clearly darker and greener than the warm-white uppers, tall cabinets and walls; oak shelves, range hood and floor must all be the same natural, neutral (non-amber, non-pink) white oak tone; layout follows the reference: sink+shelves run on the left, banquette window nook at the far end, professional range under an oak hood with tall pantry and wall ovens on the right
